notes: Large-source unit הֹלְכֵי נְתִיבוֹת → *the travellers* retained: one English word carries both morphemes' sense, exactly as דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים → *chronicles* does under rule 30, so neither member may be rendered while the other is marked unrepresented. The supplied *the* joins the fused nominal expression (rule 15).

Large-source unit אֳרָחוֹת עֲקַלְקַלּוֹת → *byways* retained on the same terms, headed on the phrase's head noun (rule 23); the supplied *through* is licensed by the adverbial accusative (rule 33). The marginal literal *crooked ways* corroborates the fusion without deciding it (rules 7, 38).
Margin *Or, the caravans ceased* read and set aside (rule 38).
